milestone: Harness-owned instructions under shared Workcell contracts

issues.body:
Create a vendor-neutral checker under docs/models/check. Define prompting.md provenance fields (model, official source URLs, fetched date, extractor version, normalized source digests), selected-content format, --check, --model, deterministic fixture injection, and intentional update mode. Refetch article content, distinguish network/extraction failure from drift, name model and URL, and never rewrite under --check. Vendor selectors are adapters behind one scanner. Execution: headless Antigravity (`agy`), model `gemini-3.7-flash`, effort high, via the use-other-harness skill; issues within a wave run in parallel, one workspace each.

## Definition of Done (tests)

- [ ] **required-header-is-enforced** (unit) - Fixture extracts missing each required provenance field make check_guides.py --check exit non-zero naming file and field; a complete fixture passes. (test: `docs/models/check/tests/test_check_guides.py`)
- [ ] **upstream-drift-is-loud-and-read-only** (integration) - Unchanged normalized fixture content exits 0; changing a selected passage or article digest exits non-zero naming drift/model/URL and leaves the stored extract byte-identical. (test: `docs/models/check/tests/test_check_guides.py`)
- [ ] **fetch-failure-is-not-freshness** (unit) - Timeout, non-2xx, or missing article selector exits non-zero as fetch/extraction failure and never reports fresh. (test: `docs/models/check/tests/test_check_guides.py`)

<!-- workcell-planner planId=harness-owned-instructions issue=GuideFreshness -->

Add docs/models/gpt-5.6-sol/prompting.md from the official queried latest-model page. Select lean prompts, goals/constraints/success criteria, intentional effort, relevant tools, autonomy boundaries, multi-agent use, evidence-grounded progress, and final completeness. Mark API-only material that Codex cannot express. Execution: headless Antigravity (`agy`), model `gemini-3.7-flash`, effort high, via the use-other-harness skill; issues within a wave run in parallel, one workspace each.

## Definition of Done (tests)

- [ ] **gpt-guide-provenance-and-content** (unit) - The extract identifies gpt-5.6-sol, the exact official queried URL, fetch date, extractor and 64-hex digest, and has attributed sections for every Workcell lever named in scope. (test: `docs/models/gpt-5.6-sol/tests/test_extract.py`)
- [ ] **gpt-guide-is-live-fresh** (integration) - check_guides.py --check --model gpt-5.6-sol refetches the official URL and exits 0; a changed injected page exits non-zero. (test: `docs/models/gpt-5.6-sol/tests/test_extract.py`)

Create the strict shared registry for all 16 skills and 10 agents: name, invocation, ordered gates, handoff schema, acceptance oracle, required values and optional surfaces. Update agents/models.json to move grok entries from inherit to the pinned grok-4.6 model ID. Keep sync-agents.py and add sync-skills.py behind one generator. Put sources/tracked outputs under harnesses/<h>/{agents,skills,runtime}; copy shared resources. --check is read-only, catches exact drift/orphans, fails missing required values, and emits deterministic notes for unsupported optional fields. Prove four genuinely different use-other-harness bodies with identical semantics. Redirect all plan08 stagers to only their harness root and retain ADR-0023 output/install shapes. A marked migration fallback is allowed only until final cleanup. Wire sync, parity and guide checks into gates. This broad seam issue runs alone. Execution: headless Antigravity (`agy`), model `gemini-3.7-flash`, effort high, via the use-other-harness skill; issues within a wave run in parallel, one workspace each.

## Definition of Done (tests)

- [ ] **contract-registry-is-complete-and-strict** (unit) - The registry contains exactly 16 current skills and 10 current agents; every compatibility field validates, and unknown keys, duplicates or malformed values fail with a JSON path. (test: `scripts/tests/test_harness_generation.py`)
- [ ] **required-fails-optional-notes** (unit) - A missing required harness value fails naming harness/artifact/value; an unavailable optional effort/tool surface is omitted with the exact generated limitation note. (test: `scripts/tests/test_harness_generation.py`)
- [ ] **both-sync-checks-detect-real-drift** (integration) - Clean temporary outputs pass both --check commands; mutating one generated skill or agent fails and names its path without writing the real tree. (test: `scripts/tests/test_harness_generation.py`)
- [ ] **use-other-harness-proves-layering** (unit) - Four generated use-other-harness skills have equal parsed contracts/explicit-only meaning, non-identical bodies, and correct native headless commands. (test: `scripts/tests/test_harness_generation.py`)
- [ ] **each-stager-uses-only-its-family** (e2e) - A fixture with shared resources plus only harnesses/<h> builds expected dist/<h> agents/skills/runtime with no symlink, source-root text, other-harness read, or shared SKILL.md read. (test: `scripts/tests/test_harness_generation.py`)
- [ ] **new-checks-are-gated** (integration) - CI invokes agent sync --check, skill sync --check, contract parity and model-guide freshness; deleting one invocation fails the truth test by name. (test: `scripts/tests/test_docs_truth.py`)
- [ ] **grok-roster-is-pinned-to-grok-4-6** (unit) - agents/models.json pins grok defaults to grok-4.6 with no inherit entry remaining, validated by generator sync checks. (test: `scripts/tests/test_harness_generation.py`)
